comment: Blocked independent valid-direction reproduction for dig.c use_pick_axe2(): the Archeologist applies inventory pick-axe e, clears wield feedback, then chooses k from the direction list. The immediate use_pick_axe2() branch prints “You start digging.”, but C invokes the return-valued dig.c dig() occupation callback during that same recorded input; JS intentionally leaves that callback open. Monster targets also reach return-valued uhitm.c do_attack(), whose existing port still has unsupported two-weapon-ending and leprechaun-dodge arms. Keep this input-only recipe as a named blocked case; it has no matching recording.
